# gitmoap_provider_versions (Data Source)

List all published versions of a provider, newest-first. Each version's manifest and lifecycle state, active, deprecated or sunset. Paginated with `limit` (20 by default, at most 100) and `next_token`; the listing is ordered by version number, highest first, and the order carries on from one page to the next. A private provider is visible only to members of the organization that owns it; anyone else gets `404`. Open to any signed-in caller.

The token needs `provider_catalog:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) Provider slug

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `capabilities` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--capabilities))
- `changelog` (String)
- `contract_version` (Number)
- `cosign_signature_ref` (String) Where the cosign signature is stored in the registry, when the images are signed.
- `lifecycle_state` (String) Lifecycle state of a published `ProviderVersionManifest`. `Active` is the
default; `Deprecated` still runs but the trigger-time validator surfaces a
warning; `Sunset` runs only inside its grace window, after which a trigger
referencing it fails validation.
- `manifest_digest` (String) The SHA-256 digest of the version's `gitmoap-provider.yaml`. May be empty.
- `provider_id` (String)
- `published_at` (String)
- `published_by` (String) `"platform"` for platform-authored providers; a publisher id otherwise.
- `signed` (Boolean) Whether the version's images are signed with gitmoap's cosign key, as verified and
platform providers' are.
- `sunset_at` (String) When the version was sunset. Set only for a sunset version.
- `sunset_enforced_at` (String) When the sunset's grace period ends. After it, a run that uses the version fails to start.
- `version` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `bindable` (List of String) Config keys that can take their value from an earlier step. Each has an optional `value`
input port of the same name: connect it and read it with `{"$from": "<key>"}`, or leave it
unconnected and write the value yourself.
- `cache_enabled` (Boolean)
- `capability_id` (String)
- `default_timeout_seconds` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `image_digest` (String) The exact build of the capability's container image, when the catalog records one. Pinned so
a run cannot pick up a different build behind the same tag.
- `image_uri` (String) The container image that runs the capability, with an immutable version tag.
- `input_groups` (Attributes List) Rules about which inputs are alternatives to each other. Empty for most capabilities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--capabilities--input_groups))
- `inputs` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--capabilities--inputs))
- `name` (String)
- `outputs` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--capabilities--outputs))
- `requires_docker` (Boolean)
- `source_image_ref` (String) For a verified provider, the image's location in its publisher's registry before gitmoap
copied it. Absent for providers gitmoap builds itself.
- `stage_type` (String) The pipeline stage a capability belongs to. Maps verbatim to the
`stage_type` field of a capability in `gitmoap-provider.yaml`.

<a id="nestedatt--items--capabilities--input_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.capabilities.input_groups`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Why these ports constrain each other, in the provider's own words. Rendered beside the
group, and repeated in the validation error when the group is unsatisfied — which is the
point: the sentence explaining the rule reaches the person who broke it.
- `kind` (String) How many of a group's ports may be connected.
- `ports` (List of String) The member input ports, in the order the author should read them.


<a id="nestedatt--items--capabilities--inputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.capabilities.inputs`

Read-Only:

- `cardinality` (String) How many connections an input port accepts: `one` (the default) or `many`, in which case the
step waits for every connected source. An output can always feed any number of inputs.
- `description` (String) What this port is for, in the provider's own words. Absent on a few older providers.
- `name` (String)
- `port_type` (String) What kind of data a port carries. Two ports connect only when their types match.
- `required` (Boolean)
- `schema_id` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--items--capabilities--outputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.capabilities.outputs`

Read-Only:

- `cardinality` (String) How many connections an input port accepts: `one` (the default) or `many`, in which case the
step waits for every connected source. An output can always feed any number of inputs.
- `description` (String) What this port is for, in the provider's own words. Absent on a few older providers.
- `name` (String)
- `port_type` (String) What kind of data a port carries. Two ports connect only when their types match.
- `required` (Boolean)
- `schema_id` (String)
